Definition: dative case singular masculine or neuter of G3778; to (in, with or by) this (person or thing):--here(-by, -in), him, one, the same, there(-in), this.
BiblicalUsage: To this, by this, in this — the word that points at the one in front of you. The centurion says, I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; Jesus says no word against the Holy Ghost shall be forgiven, neither in this world nor in the world to come; and the centurion says the same again in Luke.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word carries the centurion's whole faith in miniature: authority that reaches to this man, and judgment that reaches to this world.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
